Characterization of load cell capabilities Analog-passive load cell
Maximum capacity (Emax) 3 kg up to and including 50 kg
Minimum dead load 0 kg
Accuracy Class C3 C4 C5
Rated Output 2,0 mV/V ± 0,2 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) (1) 3000 4000 5000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval (1)
Y = Emax / Vmin		 10000 15000 20000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return (1)
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 3000 6000 7500
Input impedance 409 Ω ± 6 Ω
Temperature range -10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH
Safe overload 150 % of Emax
Output impedance 350 Ω ± 3 Ω
Recommended excitation 5 – 12 V AC / DC
Excitation maximum 18 V AC / DC
Transducer material Aluminium alloy
Atmospheric protection Silicon rubber
